releaseNotes: 20.12.0 hotfix: fixes a fatal DOM selector error in the shared profile header renderer that could stop main app initialization. All duplicate coin/avatar headers now update safely. Daily drop buttons share one claim action; duplicate home navigation/search controls all respond. Shared local-profile rewards include the main game modes, Battle World, Battle Pass missions, Player Journey, Black Zone and NEXUS World systems. Local saves retained; no new online server.
